note: The label-matching test set: what a vision model actually emits when it names food in French. Short, common, unqualified — the vocabulary of a plate, not of a composition table. None of these is a Ciqual label; feeding the resolver the strings it indexes would prove nothing. `accept` lists the Ciqual alim_codes that count as the right food for the term: the generic raw or plainly cooked entry a dietitian would pick, plus its equally-right neighbours (the '(aliment moyen)' row, the same food cooked another plain way). Anything else at the top of the ranking is a wrong food. An empty `accept` means Ciqual has no row for the term, so the only right answer is not to resolve it. Run by server/__tests__/postgresFoodMatching.test.ts and printed by scripts/food-matching-report.mjs.
